component.name: Lunduke Paint
component.summary: Layered bitmap paint program for Linux X11

description.p: Lunduke Paint is a traditional GTK 3 paint program for Linux X11. Look and feel: classic MS Paint plus KolourPaint, with user layers and a visible history list.
It uses a window-manager title bar, a menu bar, and toolbars. The native project format is OpenRaster (.ora). Load PNG, JPEG, BMP, and GIF. Flat export to PNG, JPEG, and BMP is supported.

Lunduke Paint 0.5 for LCOS 0.5. 0.5-11: toolbox symbolic icons currentColor + theme_fg at load (no washed grey). 0.5-10: new app icon (hicolor PNGs 16–512; drop scalable SVG). 0.5-9: stroke/brush/spray pickers match toolbox theme_bg; no left status-bar chatter. 0.5-8: drop black border box around left-rail line-width / brush / spray pickers. 0.5-7: pattern strip without FG/BG wells (Colors panel only). 0.5-6: Colors panel shade-columns + Custom "+"; drop duplicate Colors label. 0.5-5: separator under left tool grid; Layers thumbnail beside visibility/lock. 0.5-4: two-row patterns, left-rail brush/stroke options (no under-canvas tool strip), Layers grow + icon Delete/Rename/Add + DnD reorder. 0.5-2: R-F03 selection-move checker fix.
Lunduke Paint 0.4-3: dock recenter, Save dialog sizing/extension sync, About tagline, wand/freeform icon sizing, selection-move checker fix, Color Eraser removed.
Lunduke Paint 0.3: Foreground/Background well labels, equal-width tool columns. Howdy intro sources retained but not shown on launch by default.
Lunduke Paint 0.2 for LCOS: Open from the OS, crash recovery, Copy Merged, system fonts, magic wand, and GIF load.
